documents.text: This is an underground sight , so we did not visit it – I am claustrophobic ! On a side street alongside the bar is an unimpressive door which you can open onto the Ipogeo Celtico . This is a series of rock chambers , or grottoes , carved close to the cliff face . No-one knows how old the caves are , who dug them , or why .
